name: daily-plate
description: Daily Plate - a private family food journal. Log what you had. See where you stand. Get on with your day.

scripts.build: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @daily-plate/server run build && pnpm --filter @daily-plate/web run build
scripts.verify: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @daily-plate/server run build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm --filter @daily-plate/web run build
scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @daily-plate/domain run build && pnpm --filter @daily-plate/contracts run build
